definitions.explanation: A deliberate course of action or method devised to achieve a particular goal. Often used in formal or policy-related contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧な{方策|ほうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
⟦{問題|もんだい}{解決|かいけつ}→問題解決：26071_mondaikaiketsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{方策|ほうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: We discussed strategies for solving the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少子化|しょうしか}→少子化：04807_shoushika⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{方策|ほうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{出|だ}している→打ち出す：06790_uchidasu⟧。
examples.english: The government has put forward various measures to address the declining birthrate.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word used in business, government, and academic contexts. More formal than ⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧ (method) and implies deliberate planning toward a goal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {方策|ほうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{講|こう}じる→講じる：27841_koujiru⟧ (to take measures)
- {方策|ほうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧ (to devise a strategy)
- ⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧な{方策|ほうさく} (concrete measures)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: countermeasure — focused on responding to a specific problem
- ⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: method — more general and less formal
- ⟦{施策|しさく}→施策：18514_shisaku⟧: policy measure — specifically government or organizational action
